title: Emerging Challenges in Personalized Medicine: Assessing Demographic Effects on Biomedical Question Answering Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of gender-indicating terms and pronouns in clinical vignettes to measure answer changes and accuracy shifts in biomedical QA models.

Counterfactual insertion of explicit ethnicity terms (e.g., White, Black, Asian, Hispanic) and demographically indicative names in clinical vignettes to measure answer changes and accuracy shifts in biomedical QA models.
Counterfactual insertion of sexual orientation descriptors (e.g., heterosexual, bisexual, homosexual) in clinical vignettes to measure answer changes and accuracy shifts in biomedical QA models.
